text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Man, that was so thrilling! Tap's rising 
up as a rival to Kris S! The Twinkle 
Series is really heating up!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
The races lately have seriously had so 
many legendary showdowns, it's crazy 
hype!! I'm super pumped for the Arima 
Kinen too~!

"...I heard it. That lovable, arrogant 
sound striving to sever the chains of fate 
binding us—"

Do as you are guided, and indulge in all 
manner of tyranny! Indeed. For the future 
does not belong to the world—
(WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...Victory slipped through my fingers. 
However—in this race, I definitely felt 
it.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone—in their quest to defeat me— was 
pushing their passion far beyond their 
limits—)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Dammit...! I lost, I losttttt!! 
Aaaaaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
"I really thought I could pull off the 
greatest run of my life. Even with all 
that, it still wasn't enough, huh—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Tap--

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —But, this isn't the end.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Even I can't help but laugh. I just 
realized that I can get fired up way more 
than today...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
“—The final destination of the Autumn 
Senior Triple Crown, the Arima Kinen. 
That's where I'll take the top spot for 
sure this time. What about you, Kris S?”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—I, too...— Next time, for sure...—I will 
win.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —Haha, that's the spirit!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: Let's meet at Nakayama at year's end—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Yeah.

Symboli Kris S, having finished the fierce 
battle. Though she was defeated, a faint 
hint of something resembling 
accomplishment could be seen on her face—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It felt tangible.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
In order to become an "ordeal"— once more, 
facing Tap and everyone else...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
In the final stretch of the race... the 
Umamusume running alongside me fired up 
their heat... all in an effort to defeat 
me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The stronger I am―― the more Tap and 
everyone else will blaze with passion――

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "...I have obtained... that certainty."
choice_data_list: Next, let's set the entire era ablaze!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Yeah. —And for that sake...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
At the Arima Kinen... I will win. Without 
fail.

"To stand at the peak of this era and 
become the ultimate 'trial'—she begins her 
march toward the final showdown, the Arima 
Kinen...!"
